items.name: Talatona Speedcubing Open 2025
items.information:
🇦🇴 **Bem-vindos á mais uma competição de cubo mágico em Angola!**

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TalatonaSpeedcubingOpen2025/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista a [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade.

---

🇺🇸 **Welcome to another Rubik's Cube competition in Angola!**

Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TalatonaSpeedcubingOpen2025/register) tab. If you have any problem with how to register, take a look at [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality.

**IEEE Cubing Nepal 2025** is organized in coordination with the **IEEE Computer Society Pulchowk Student Branch Chapter**. This Rubik’s Cube competition welcomes cubers from all around the world to participate, compete, and celebrate their passion for cubing.

For more updates on events and activities by the Computer Society Chapter, check out [Pulchowk Computer Society on Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/pulchowkcompsbc/).

Please take a look at the other tabs for more details. You can [contact](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IEEECubingNepal2025#60043-contact-info) us for any queries.

items.information:
# **This competition is part of the Tooele Open 2025 Series alongside Tooele Open A; you may only register for one competition in the series**

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full). If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab. 
​
For questions regarding deadlines, registrations, and the competition waitlist, please see the Registration and Waitlist Info tab. 
​
Go to our [website](https://utahcubing.org) to find links to our Facebook group, Instagram page, and the Rockies Discord Server to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!

items.name: CubingUSA New England Quiet Championship 2025

venue.name: Whitney Place at Natick - SALMON Health and Retirement
venue.details: first floor on the left just past the reception desk

items.information:
This competition is part of the [CubingUSA New England Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NewEnglandChampionship2025)! Podium winners and champions of each events will be recognized at the main competition, two weeks later in Portland.

This competition is open to all competitors, but only competitors who are residents of Massachusetts, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Vermont, New Hampshire, and Maine are eligible to win the title of New England Champion.

The only events at this competition will be 3x3x3 Multiple Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4x4 Blindfolded, and 5x5x5 Blindfolded. First-time competitors are welcome, however we will not be holding the normal speedsolving events, and so you may prefer to attend a different competition, such as the main championship two weeks later.

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
